title: Base-changed edge maps carry the unit of a composite to the pullback
statement:
Let $f:Y\to X$, $\pi:Y'\to Y$ and $i:Z\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f'=f\circ\pi$, and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Put $Y_Z=Y\times_XZ$ and $Y'_Z=Y'\times_XZ$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $i_Y:Y_Z\to Y$, $f_Z:Y_Z\to Z$, $i_{Y'}:Y'_Z\to Y'$, $f'_Z:Y'_Z\to Z$, and let $\pi_Z=\pi\times_X\mathrm{id}_Z:Y'_Z\to Y_Z$, so that $i_Y\pi_Z=\pi i_{Y'}$ and $f_Z\pi_Z=f'_Z$; regard the two squares $(f,f_Z,i,i_Y)$ and $(f',f'_Z,i,i_{Y'})$ as cartesian squares [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $\theta$ built from the composition isomorphisms as in [lem-weil-pbc-edge-map-base-change]. For a cartesian square $\square=(h,h',i,i')$ with $h:W\to X$ and an abelian sheaf $E$ on $W_{\Et}$ write
$$\Phi^q_{\square,E}=e^q_{h',i'^{-1}E}\circ H^q(\Ex^0_{\square,E}):H^q(Z_{\Et},i^{-1}h_*E)\to H^q((W\times_XZ)_{\Et},i'^{-1}E),$$
with $\Ex^0$ the underived exchange morphism [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] and $e^q$ the edge map of [lem-weil-pbc-edge-map-base-change] (pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] followed by $H^q$ of the counit). Let $u:f_*G\to f'_*\pi^{-1}G$ be $f_*(\eta_{\pi,G}):f_*G\to f_*\pi_*\pi^{-1}G$ followed by the identification $f_*\pi_*=(f\pi)_*$ of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] ($\eta_\pi$ the unit of $\pi^{-1}\dashv\pi_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]), and let $\kappa:\pi_Z^{-1}i_Y^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}i_{Y'}^{-1}\pi^{-1}G$ be the composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] for $i_Y\pi_Z=\pi i_{Y'}$, i.e. $\kappa=c_{\pi,i_{Y'},G}^{-1}\circ c_{i_Y,\pi_Z,G}$ through $(i_Y\pi_Z)^{-1}G=(\pi i_{Y'})^{-1}G$. Then for every $q\ge0$
$$\Phi^q_{(f',f'_Z,i,i_{Y'}),\pi^{-1}G}\circ H^q(i^{-1}u)=H^q(\kappa)\circ\pi_Z^*\circ\Phi^q_{(f,f_Z,i,i_Y),G}:\ H^q(Z_{\Et},i^{-1}f_*G)\to H^q((Y'_Z)_{\Et},i_{Y'}^{-1}\pi^{-1}G),$$
$H^q(\varphi)$ denoting the map induced by a morphism of sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]. No finiteness is needed; the case $Z=X$, $i=\mathrm{id}$ is allowed. (Intended proof: [lem-weil-pbc-edge-map-base-change] for both squares reduces the claim to the case $i=\mathrm{id}$, where it follows from clauses 3 (naturality) and 4 (composition) of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] and the triangle identity $\varepsilon_{f'}\circ f'^{-1}(u)=\pi^{-1}(\varepsilon_f)$ composed with the identifications, up to the composition isomorphisms.)

proof.text: Set F = f_* G, B = i^* F, E = π^* G, U = f_*(η_π,G) followed by lowerStarComp.hom, and V = i^* U. Substitute fZ′ = πZ ≫ fZ using hZ. Keep the statement and all its hypotheses unchanged.

Prove the composite-counit identity in the private lemma counit_pushforward_unit: (π ≫ f)^*(U) followed by ε_(π ≫ f),E equals upperStarComp.hom at F followed by π^*(ε_f,G). Precompose by upperStarComp.inv, use its naturality and the source library upperStarComp_inv_app_counit_app. Functoriality cancels lowerStarComp.hom with its inverse. Naturality of ε_f at η_π,G and the left triangle identity for π finish the computation.

Let θ₁ and θ₂ be the squareUpperStarIso components for sq and sq′, ε₁ = iY^*(ε_f,G), ε₂ = iY′^*(ε_(π ≫ f),E), κ = squareUpperStarIso(sqπ).hom at G, and c = upperStarComp(πZ,fZ).hom at B. Prove the sheaf identity (πZ ≫ fZ)^*(V) ≫ θ₂ ≫ ε₂ = c ≫ πZ^*(θ₁ ≫ ε₁) ≫ κ. Naturality of θ₂ moves U to iY′^*(π ≫ f)^*(U); apply the preceding counit identity. The already-proved squareUpperStarIso_paste_vert_hom applied to sqπ and sq rewrites the square comparison at F. Cancel the mapped upperStarComp inverse/hom pair and use naturality of κ at ε_f,G. This directly supplies the comparison calculation of the original steps 5–7 without derived inverse images.

The private lemma exchange_edge_apply writes exchange followed by the edge map as H^q(θ ≫ pullback(ε)) after cohomology pullback. Apply cohomologyMap_map to the exchange, combine the two H^q maps by Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, and use upperStar_map_baseChangeMap_app_counit. This is valid for any commutative square and needs neither finite morphisms nor resolutions.

Evaluate the desired equality at an arbitrary x in H^q(Z,B), and apply exchange_edge_apply to sq′ at H^q(V)(x) and to sq at x. Naturality of cohomological pullback gives the left side as H^q((πZ ≫ fZ)^*(V) ≫ θ₂ ≫ ε₂) applied to d = (πZ ≫ fZ)^*(x). For the right side first use naturality along πZ at θ₁ ≫ ε₁; clause 2 of the Lean theorem cohomologyPullbackFunctorial (the composition clause) identifies πZ^* fZ^*(x) with H^q(c)(d). Combine H^q maps to get H^q(c ≫ πZ^*(θ₁ ≫ ε₁) ≫ κ)(d). Apply H^q to the sheaf identity and conclude by extensionality. The original unit route is preserved; the item is not itself a realized statement or step of sk-thm-p1.

split_report.summary: Statement kept; kappa made explicit as c_{pi,i_Y'}^{-1} o c_{i_Y,pi_Z} (the only reading of 'the composition isomorphism for i_Y pi_Z = pi i_Y''). Agent-written proof in eight steps, not via the reduction to i = id suggested in the statement (both sides are computed directly): (1) conventions (one morphism k for all composites, fixed resolutions, functoriality of H^q in the sheaf); (2) Phi_square = H^q(phi_square) o h'^*, phi_square = i'^{-1}(eps_h) o theta, by the adjunct-counit identity and clause 3 of lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial; (3) both sides become H^q(...) o f'_Z^* by clauses 3 and 4 (composition for f'_Z = f_Z pi_Z), reducing to an identity (star) of sheaf morphisms; (4) eps_{f'} o f'^{-1}(u) = pi^{-1}(eps_f) o c_{f,pi}^{-1} from the unit equation of c_{f,pi}, naturality of eta_pi and the triangle identity; (5), (6) naturality of the c's and of kappa; (7) the remaining identity of composition isomorphisms from the associativity of c (lem-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-composition (1), on the route through sk-def-exchange) applied to (f,pi,i_Y'), (f,i_Y,pi_Z), (i,f_Z,pi_Z); (8) conclusion. No new nodes. Mathlib searched three ways (leansearch, leanfinder, loogle, grep): no match.
